title: You can now open Claude directly in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides (and vice versa, open and edit the files in Claude)
key_facts: Claude for Google Workspace add-on is in public beta starting 6 Oct 2026
A sidebar opens beside a file in Docs, Sheets or Slides
Docs: fix spelling, rewrite portions, restyle sections without breaking formatting
Sheets: write formulas, build tables from document context, build new sheets from uploaded files
Slides: build slides from existing layouts or themes, flag elements to update
Available to all paid Claude users via the Google Workspace marketplace
New Claude connectors edit Docs, Sheets and Slides files from within Claude by pasting a link
quote_evidence: Anthropic's Claude now supports sidebar integration with Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides.
There’s an “ask before edits” mode where Claude will let you preview changes before they’re made.
The Claude for Google Workspace beta is available to all paid Claude users through the Google Workspace marketplace.
why_it_matters_hint: Claude users can now work with it inside Google's apps, a direct challenge to Gemini in Workspace.
